title: Terms of Use
summary: A clear agreement for your own drinking diary.

sections.heading: 1. Who provides Drytally

These Terms apply to the Drytally iPhone app and this product website. Apple and other suppliers have their own terms for services they provide.

Please read these Terms and our Privacy Policy before using the app. The Privacy Policy explains data practices; accepting these Terms is not blanket consent to optional health access, notifications, photo access, advertising or any other separate processing. Those choices remain separate.

sections.heading: 2. Eligibility and your choices

If you are under the age of legal majority where you live, a parent or guardian must review and agree where required by law. Any higher age restriction in the App Store or local law also applies. The app does not encourage anyone to obtain or consume alcohol.

You do not need a Drytally account to keep a diary. You are responsible for your device, any Apple Account used for purchases, and the accuracy of information you enter. Do not provide us with another person’s sensitive information without a lawful basis.

sections.heading: 3. What the app does
paragraphs: Drytally helps you record drinks, alcohol-free days, notes and selected photos, and view your own calendar, totals and patterns. Optional features include reminders, Apple Health writing, widgets, sharing and export. Some features require Pro. Availability depends on the version, device, permissions and purchase status.

Unlogged days are not the same as confirmed alcohol-free days. Counts, prices, calories and trends depend on your inputs and settings and may be estimates. You should check information before relying on it or sharing it.

sections.heading: 4. Health and service limits
paragraphs: Drytally is a personal record-keeping tool, not a medical device, clinical assessment, treatment programme or emergency service. It does not diagnose alcohol dependence, determine whether drinking is safe, or replace advice from a qualified health professional. It makes no promise of sobriety, weight change, health improvement or any particular outcome.

Use professional medical advice when making decisions about your health or changing alcohol use. Do not delay seeking care because of information shown in the app. If there is an emergency, contact the emergency service available where you are.

sections.heading: 10. Your records, device storage and exports
paragraphs: Your diary, notes, selected diary photos, profile and onboarding answers are stored on your device. A widget uses a shared container on the same device. The current app does not provide cross-device diary sync or our own cloud diary backup. We cannot recover a diary we do not hold.

Protect your device and consider available export and Apple device-backup options. Uninstalling the app or resetting its data may remove local records. An export sent to Files, email or another app is controlled by you and the receiving service. Apple Health copies and separately saved exports may remain after the app is deleted and must be managed in those destinations.
